definitions.wallClock: First attempt: run creation to last job completion. Rerun: run_started_at to last job completion; idle time between attempts excluded.
definitions.phaseSeconds: Named Actions step durations; null means unseparated/not instrumented, not zero. Download-related phases overlap setup/install and include other work. Native verification includes Docker image builds and compose; OCI includes build and runtime checks.
definitions.coldSetup: Only PR30 task-created pnpm cache IDs 9398637393/9398572262 at refs/pull/30/merge were removed, then full attempt2 rerun at the same immutable SHA. Empty cache confirmed before rerun; later jobs may hit caches populated by earlier jobs in that run.
definitions.cacheScope: 47 jobs use explicit pnpm cache. OCI core/full and certification do not; their NOT_CHECKED is not a cache hit claim.
